mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the retinas to the focusing parts was most worthwhile because it showed the complete path of light to the detecting lining.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the lenses and irises separately was a little repetitive as gameplay, though their different jobs were clearly shown.

surprise.text: The lens comparison showed that flatter and rounder shapes bend light by different amounts; I hadn't known what difference the shapes made.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. Some later steps had only one combination, but their purpose was clear from the pictures and goals.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: seeing the separate eye parts come together into a working path was satisfying, even if several choices were straightforward.
